text:
ben_harrison: quick heads up — preflight prompt-suite run (v12 + new quant profile) flagged a regression on summarizer-fluency and email-formatter tests, failing CI thresholds. thinking we should gate the release until triage. :frowning:
carla_prod: link to the run? can you paste the failing diffs?
ben_harrison: https://ci.redwood/suites/2026-03-20/ps-v12-run-42 — main diffs at the top of the report. failures look concentrated on longer-context examples and a few tokenization edge cases.
sam_qa: summary: 12/240 prompts exceed fluency delta threshold, 5/120 email templates produce truncated fields. overall pass rate dropped from 98.2% -> 93.6%. attaching a quick snippet:
```
Input: "Summarize this long thread and preserve action items"
Expected: "Action items: ..."
Model(v11): "Action items: 1) review PR, 2) deploy"
Model(v12+quant): "Action items:"
```
sam_qa: repro is consistent on dedicated GPU with quant profile q8_ae. non-quantized v12 matches v11.
deploybot: deploybot: preflight-run 3612468000 — status = flagged_by_eval_gate. Auto-hold applied to release branch release/2026-03-20.
carla_prod: ok thanks. ben, can we do a quick bisect to confirm if quant kernels introduced this? if yes, we can pin runtime or fallback quant profile in two hours.
ben_harrison: plan proposal: 1) revert quant profile to q16 for canary (fast change, low infra risk) 2) keep v12 code in the branch but mark model variant as experimental 3) if q16 fixes, permit canary in eu region only and run expanded prompt-suite 4) if not fixed within 2h, pin model to v11 for the full release and follow up postmortem. thoughts?
carla_prod: +1 to that plan. please include wording for release notes: "v12 held for quant-related regression; v11 remains GA for this window."
releasebot: releasebot: hold applied: release/2026-03-20 — hold_reason: eval_regression — actions: set_canary_regions=[eu], block_full_rollout=true.
nora_sre: note: switching q16 will change GPU memory usage ~+10%. we have headroom in eu but monitor closely. ops alert if OOMs spike.
sam_qa: i'll run the q16 canary sweep once ben flips the profile and report back within 45 minutes. adding focused tests for truncated emails.
ben_harrison: making the quick config change now:
```
# runtime config
quant_profile: q16
model_variant: v12-canary
```
ben_harrison: pushed config change and kicked the sweep.
sam_qa: sweep started. current progress 18/240. so far no truncation on first 18.
carla_prod: updating the release notes draft and the change window page. also pinging legal for the audit entry. :memo:
ben_harrison: if sweep stays green, we do a limited eu canary and keep the hold on global rollout until tomorrow morning change window. if it fails we pin to v11 and cut a hotfix plan.
deploybot: deploybot: canary rollout scheduled to eu-1 at 3612468400 with model_variant=v12-canary and quant_profile=q16, monitoring hooks attached.
carla_prod: thanks everyone. please post final decision here once sweep completes. :thumbsup:
